CSharpGitServiceImpl - Extended GitService that supports C# files alongside Java files This class extends the standard GitServiceImpl to detect and process .cs files in addition to .java files, enabling RefactoringMiner to work with C# repositories.

CSharpToJavaConverter
CSharpToJavaConverter - Converts C# syntax to Java-like syntax This converter transforms C# language constructs into equivalent Java constructs that RefactoringMiner's Java AST parser can understand, preserving the semantic structure needed for refactoring detection.
CSharpUMLModelASTReader
CSharpUMLModelASTReader - Creates UMLModel from CPatMiner generated AST This class extends the standard UMLModelASTReader to work with CompilationUnit ASTs generated by CPatMiner from C# source code, providing proper integration between CPatMiner's AST output and RefactoringMiner's UMLModel system.
